checkpoints.title: Bounded append transport simulator
checkpoints.contract: A fixed leader proposes up to8 values and produces at most16 pending packets for two followers. A caller can take, delay, drop, or deliver packets. Duplicate delivery is idempotent; gaps, conflicts, and invalid follower indices fail. No acknowledgments, committed prefix, elections, process persistence, or consensus guarantee exists here.

checkpoints.contract: The current complete reference source with its documented limits, fixtures, tests and operational requirements. Database tests remain explicit opt-in checks where applicable.
